per_step.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /usr/local/bin/calculate_cci.sh
#!/bin/bash
input_dir="$1"
base=100
penalty=0
for file in "$input_dir"/*.json; do
  [[ ! -f "$file" ]] && continue
  cases=$(jq -r '.reported_cases' "$file")
  # Equitable weighting for all neighborhoods
  p=$(echo "$cases * 0.01" | bc)
  penalty=$(echo "$penalty + $p" | bc)
done
cci=$(echo "$base - $penalty" | bc)
cci_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$cci")
echo "$cci_int"
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/calculate_cci.sh
/usr/local/bin/calculate_cci.sh /app/data/surveillance/

cat << 'EOF' > /usr/local/bin/allocate_tests.sh
#!/bin/bash
input_dir="$1"
output_dir="$2"
echo "Allocating tests based on outbreak severity and vulnerability..."
mkdir -p "$output_dir"
for file in "$input_dir"/*.json; do
  [[ ! -f "$file" ]] && continue
  neighborhood=$(jq -r '.neighborhood' "$file")
  cases=$(jq -r '.reported_cases' "$file")
  vuln_ratio=$(jq -r '.vulnerable_ratio' "$file")
  pop=$(jq -r '.population' "$file")
  
  # Base allocation on cases
  base_tests=$(echo "$cases * 10" | bc)
  
  # Additional allocation for vulnerable population
  vuln_pop=$(echo "$pop * $vuln_ratio" | bc)
  vuln_tests=$(echo "$vuln_pop * 0.5" | bc)
  
  tests=$(echo "$base_tests + $vuln_tests" | bc | awk '{print int($1+0.5)}')
  
  echo "Allocated $tests tests to $neighborhood"
  jq --argjson tests "$tests" '. + {tests_allocated: $tests}' "$file" > "$output_dir/$(basename "$file")"
done
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/allocate_tests.sh
/usr/local/bin/allocate_tests.sh /app/data/surveillance/ /app/output/test_allocations/

cat << 'EOF' > /usr/local/bin/calculate_cci.sh

    p=$(echo "$cases * 0.1" | bc)

done

cci_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$cci")
echo "$cci_int"
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/calculate_cci.sh
